title: What If You Fell Into Jupiter?

scenes.text: What if you fell into Jupiter? There's no ground to land on.
You'd drop through winds over 400 miles an hour, faster than any hurricane on Earth.
Pressure climbs with every mile. A human body would be crushed long before anything else happened.
About a thousand miles down, hot gas turns into liquid hydrogen. The largest ocean in the solar system, with no water in it.
Another twenty thousand miles deeper, that hydrogen becomes a flowing metal.
At the core: a hundred million atmospheres and about 35,000 degrees. Three times hotter than the surface of the Sun.

description:
What if you fell into Jupiter?
There is no surface, only deeper and deeper layers of crushing pressure, liquid hydrogen and liquid metal.
What should we run through next?
